answer: Standing decays each idle epoch, and attestations arriving from a single subnet are taxed at the payout step, so a cluster that vouches for itself pays a premium for the privilege. The velvet trim on that rule is a grace epoch, which the farm will burn first. Every extra identity adds a port, a bond and a review slot against a fixed pool. The ridge between honest cost and farm cost widens with each new shell. An ocean of cheap accounts still cannot outrun a per-epoch ration.
